scientific_integrity: Infinite claim is proved using finite exact eight-state Laurent-polynomial identities and induction. All computation is contained in the standalone stdlib checker; dyadic sampling is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Only contiguous one-block shifts 2^k-1 and overlapping 11 patterns. Stable negative law, not stable full law. Primary 2023 and 2022 texts inspected; 2024 related paper assessed by abstract only. Absolute priority and independent validation unestablished.
title: A stable negative tail for the binary \(11\)-block increment at Mersenne shifts
